es: Comparar dos opciones hipotéticas con beneficio y límite.
Concluir una recomendación según una prioridad explícita.

teaching.en: State one benefit for each option.
teaching.es: Indica un beneficio de cada opción.
teaching.explanationEs: La comparación necesita información favorable equilibrada.
teaching.audioText: State one benefit for each option.

teaching.en: Add a limit with but or although.
teaching.es: Añade un límite con but o although.
teaching.explanationEs: El contraste evita presentar una opción como perfecta.
teaching.audioText: Add a limit with but or although.

teaching.en: However can introduce the main difficulty.
teaching.es: However puede introducir la dificultad principal.
teaching.explanationEs: El conector separa beneficio y límite.
teaching.audioText: However can introduce the main difficulty.

teaching.en: Use the priority to evaluate both options.
teaching.es: Usa la prioridad para evaluar ambas opciones.
teaching.explanationEs: La elección debe responder al criterio dado.
teaching.audioText: Use the priority to evaluate both options.

teaching.explanationEs: If más pasado y would expresan la elección imaginada.

teaching.en: If I studied abroad, a large city would offer more courses but cost more. A smaller city could be cheaper, although it might offer fewer subjects. If my priority were course choice, I would select the large city. If saving money mattered more, I would choose the smaller one. The final conclusion depends on the learner's stated priority in practice.
teaching.es: El modelo compara dos destinos, sus beneficios, sus límites y concluye según una prioridad.
teaching.explanationEs: La recomendación conectada no omite ninguna de las dos opciones.

prompt.es: Elige la comparación que incluye beneficio y límite.

choices.text: A village would be peaceful, but transport could be limited.
A village could offer quiet streets and friendly local shops.
Village buses would run less often than city buses.

feedback.es: Peaceful aporta el beneficio y limited transport el límite.

hint.es: Busca una ventaja unida a una dificultad con but.

prompt.es: Completa la conclusión: If I chose one, I ___ choose Lisbon.

feedback.es: Would choose convierte la comparación en una conclusión hipotética.

hint.es: La conclusión requiere would más verbo base.

prompt.es: Ordena el límite de estudiar en una capital.

answer.text: However, rent could be more expensive there.

feedback.es: However introduce el coste que limita la opción de la capital.

hint.es: Abre con el conector de contraste.

prompt.es: Une cada opción con beneficio y límite.

feedback.es: Cada destino conserva una ventaja y un límite distintos.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la preferencia final.

feedback.es: La conclusión explícita selecciona Leipzig pese a su mercado menor.

origin.audio: Berlin would offer more jobs, but rent could be high. Leipzig would be cheaper, but the market is smaller. If I had to choose, I would live in Leipzig.

prompt.es: Compara dos formas de viajar y concluye.

answer.text: The train would be comfortable but expensive. The bus would be cheaper but slower. If I wanted to save money, I would take the bus.
accepted: The train would be comfortable but expensive. The bus would be cheaper but slower. If I wanted to save money, I would take the bus.
A train could offer more comfort, although it would cost more. A bus would take longer but cost less, so I would choose it to save money.

feedback.es: Las variantes comparan las dos opciones y concluyen según la prioridad.

origin.text: Tren: cómodo/caro. Autobús: barato/lento. Prioridad: ahorrar.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase presenta un límite de vivir lejos del centro?

feedback.es: Un trayecto más largo es una dificultad concreta de esa ubicación.

prompt.es: Escucha y selecciona el beneficio de la opción rural.

feedback.es: El apoyo personal es la ventaja explícita del curso rural.

origin.audio: A city course would have better equipment but large classes. A rural course could give me more personal support, although travel would be difficult.

prompt.es: Compara trabajar desde casa y en oficina.

answer.text: Home working would be flexible but lonely. An office would involve travel but keep the team together. If collaboration mattered most, I would choose the office.
accepted: Home working would be flexible but lonely. An office would involve travel but keep the team together. If collaboration mattered most, I would choose the office.
Working at home could save time, although I might feel isolated. The office would require a commute but support teamwork, so I would select it for collaboration.

feedback.es: Las opciones incluyen beneficios, límites y una conclusión basada en colaborar.

origin.text: Casa: flexible/aislado. Oficina: equipo cerca/desplazamiento. Prioridad: colaboración.

prompt.es: Escribe 60–80 palabras comparando dos lugares para estudiar.

answer.text: If I studied in Valencia, I would pay lower rent and could live near the beach. However, the limited evening classes would make daytime work difficult. Madrid would offer more course choices and better evening schedules, but housing would cost much more. Since I would need to work during the day, I would choose Madrid despite the higher rent because its timetable would fit my situation better.
accepted: If I studied in Valencia, I would pay lower rent and could live near the beach. However, the limited evening classes would make daytime work difficult. Madrid would offer more course choices and better evening schedules, but housing would cost much more. Since I would need to work during the day, I would choose Madrid despite the higher rent because its timetable would fit my situation better.

Valencia would be cheaper and I could enjoy the coast, but it would offer few classes after work. Madrid would have a wider range of evening courses, although the rent would be expensive. If I had to combine a daytime job with study, I would select Madrid. Its schedule would be the main benefit, while the housing cost would remain an important limit.

feedback.es: Ambas recomendaciones comparan dos lugares, sus límites y la prioridad laboral.

origin.text: Valencia: alquiler bajo/playa, pocas clases nocturnas. Madrid: cursos variados con clases nocturnas, alquiler alto. Prioridad: trabajar de día y estudiar de noche.

prompt.es: Elige la conclusión coherente con una prioridad de calma.

choices.text: If I wanted peace, I would choose the smaller town.
The capital would have more nightlife.

feedback.es: La localidad pequeña responde directamente a la prioridad de calma.

prompt.es: Relaciona opciones de vivienda con beneficio y límite.

feedback.es: Cada vivienda muestra una ventaja y una dificultad comparables.

answer.text: If I travelled to Porto, I would take a direct train and save travel time. However, meals could be expensive there. Braga would require one train change, but accommodation would cost less. Since my main priority would be the lodging budget, I would choose Braga. The connection would be a minor limit, while the cheaper room would keep accommodation costs aligned with my stated priority and leave more of my budget available.
accepted: If I travelled to Porto, I would take a direct train and save travel time. However, meals could be expensive there. Braga would require one train change, but accommodation would cost less. Since my main priority would be the lodging budget, I would choose Braga. The connection would be a minor limit, while the cheaper room would keep accommodation costs aligned with my stated priority and leave more of my budget available.

Porto would be easy to reach by direct train, although eating there could cost more. Braga would involve a connection, but I could find cheaper accommodation. If keeping the room budget low were most important, I would travel to Braga. Changing trains would be inconvenient, yet the lower lodging price would satisfy my main priority and preserve more of the available budget for other stated travel costs.

feedback.es: Las versiones comparan acceso, costes y concluyen según el alojamiento.

origin.text: Oporto: tren directo/comida cara. Braga: conexión/lodging barato. Prioridad: presupuesto de alojamiento.
